Inspect REAL files:
- Ours: gauntlet/pieces/type-system/r2/ (home-desktop.png, home-mobile.png, blog-or-type-specimen.png, NOTES.md)
- Prior r1 for reference only
- Bar: gauntlet/bar/*/home-desktop.png especially eftakher, ericsin, dai-is-a-dev, pablostanley, loganliffick, evilrabbit, pham-codes
- Criteria: gauntlet/bar/WIN_CRITERIA.md and gauntlet/critics/type-system-r1.md (r1 lost)

R2 claimed Fraunces display ~79px. Blind A/B vs strongest bar type. Write gauntlet/critics/type-system-r2.md with:
piece, round, winner (us|bar|tie), biggest_gap, next_build_instruction, evidence_paths[], blind_ab_note

I’m using the caveman skill in ultra mode for the critic pass, then I’ll inspect the real R2/bar assets and write the verdict file.
